en_title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Creators Talk New Child Lead and Gory Influences | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026
cn_title: 《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》主创谈创作
subtitle: 献给电影的情书
opus_summary: 《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》主创谈儿童主角Roman、血腥场面与电影灵感。新季将于10月20日上线Netflix，以全新角色延续系列核心，并探索逐渐消失的叙事方式。

paragraphs.en: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is back with a new season on Netflix on October 20, and today IGN's Fall Fan Fest featured a new teaser to remind you why you'll want to set aside some time for a serious Netflix binge as soon as it drops.
paragraphs.cn: 《赛博朋克：边缘行者》新一季将于10月20日回归Netflix。今天的IGN秋季粉丝节公布了一支新先导预告，提醒大家为什么值得在新一季上线后腾出时间，在Netflix上好好追一番。

paragraphs.en: Season one focused on David Martinez, a student with a talent for tolerating cyberware enhancements and netrunner Lucyna "Lucy" Kushinada as they tried to survive Night City as part of its criminal underworld. Season two introduces a new story from the Edgerunners world with Roman Carax, a kid with a taste for old-fashioned movies, and Talia Yang, who is part of a cyberware partial criminal gang called Maelstrom.
paragraphs.cn: 第一季围绕学生大卫·马丁内斯和网络黑客露西娜·栉名展开。大卫天生对义体改造有很强的耐受力，而露西娜又被称为「露西」。两人置身夜之城的犯罪世界，努力求生。第二季将讲述《边缘行者》世界中的一个新故事，主角是喜欢老电影的孩子Roman Carax，以及偏爱义体改造的犯罪帮派「漩涡帮」成员Talia Yang。

paragraphs.en: After a special fan screening of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 at Anime Expo IGN got to put some questions to CD Projekt Red's Bartosz Sztybor the VP of Franchise and Saya Elder, Executive Producer - Anime about continuing the story after David and Lucy, how the New French Extremity style of horror influenced the games gorier scenes, and which character is the creator's love letter to cinema.
paragraphs.cn: Anime Expo举办《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》粉丝特别放映会后，IGN采访了CDPR系列业务副总裁Bartosz Sztybor和动画执行制片人Saya Elder。我们问到了如何在大卫与露西的故事之后继续讲述新故事、法国新极端主义恐怖风格如何影响游戏中较为血腥的场景，以及哪位角色承载了创作者写给电影的情书。

paragraphs.en: Bartosz Sztybo: Both. I’m a person that is never one hundred percent happy with what I wrote. So the success of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners was on one hand encouraging — that the stories I write can resonate with so many people. But on the other hand: “Oh, shit. I will never write anything that good again.” It was similar on other levels. From CD PROJEKT RED’s perspective and for Cyberpunk 2077 as an IP, it gave us a lot of confidence that people want such things and we have the strength to do them. But also — how do we top that?!
paragraphs.cn: Bartosz Sztybo：两者都有。我从来不会对自己写的东西百分之百满意。所以，《赛博朋克：边缘行者》的成功一方面让我备受鼓舞——原来我写的故事能引起这么多人的共鸣。但另一方面，我又会想：「哦，靠。我再也写不出这么好的东西了。」其他层面也差不多。从CDPR的角度，以及对《赛博朋克2077》这个IP而言，这次成功让我们有了很大的信心：大家想要这样的作品，而我们也有实力做出来。但同时——我们要怎么超越它？！

paragraphs.en: Saya Elder: It certainly gave us motivation! And confidence to fight for more anime projects.
paragraphs.cn: Saya Elder：这当然给了我们动力！也让我们有信心去争取更多动画项目。

paragraphs.en: With David gone, what was the biggest challenge in writing a completely new crew of mercenaries for an audience that got so attached to the first?
paragraphs.cn: 大卫已经不在了，而观众对第一季的佣兵团队又有着如此深厚的感情。在为他们创作一支全新的佣兵团队时，最大的挑战是什么？

paragraphs.en: Bartosz Sztybo: The biggest challenge was to stop thinking about David and Lucy, and not get into a trap of artificially repeating things that fans fell in love with — or trying to create something extremely opposite. Of course, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 touches on similar things. It also rhymes with Edgerunners; there’s a dialogue between those two, but only to stay true to core principles of the Edgerunners franchise. The good thing was that I already had a few ideas while writing Edgerunners, so I just had to split my writing brain in two — one half to analyze Edgerunners and be able to stay true to it with Edgerunners 2, and the other half to keep unbiased, get back to the old ideas, and have new ones that will be something fresh.
paragraphs.cn: Bartosz Sztybo：最大的挑战是放下大卫和露西，不要陷入刻意重复粉丝喜爱元素的陷阱，也不要刻意走向另一个极端。当然，《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》也会触及相似的内容。它与《赛博朋克：边缘行者》之间也有呼应，两部作品之间存在对话，但这只是为了忠于《边缘行者》系列的核心原则。好在我写《边缘行者》时就已经有了一些想法，所以我只需要把负责写作的大脑分成两半：一半用来分析《边缘行者》，让《边缘行者2》忠于前作；另一半则保持不带成见，重新审视旧想法，并构思能带来新鲜感的新点子。

paragraphs.en: Were there any areas you knew, sitting down to plan season 2, that you had to explore in the Cyberpunk 2077 world and hadn't had the chance too with season 1?
paragraphs.cn: 坐下来筹划第二季时，你们是否已经明确，有哪些《赛博朋克2077》世界中的内容是第一季没机会涉及、这次一定要探索的？

paragraphs.en: Bartosz Sztybo: I rarely think about the locations when I write or plan stories. I mostly think about themes and characters, so “unexplored areas” for me were not buildings, streets, or districts, but braindances and people working in that industry, backstories and private lives of corporate workers or again the edgerunners lifestyle but from a different perspective. Sometimes I have glimpses of scenes when I start thinking about the story and I search for visual metaphors when talking about or writing a scene, so then some places popped out, but I don’t want to spoil anything.
paragraphs.cn: Bartosz Sztybo：我在写作或构思故事时很少考虑地点，更多考虑的是主题和人物。所以，对我来说，「尚未探索的领域」不是建筑、街道或城区，而是超梦和从事这个行业的人、公司员工的过往与私生活，或是从另一个视角看待边缘行者的生活方式。有时开始构思故事时，我脑海中会闪过一些场景；在讨论或写某场戏时，我也会寻找视觉隐喻，一些地点就是这样浮现出来的，不过我不想剧透。

paragraphs.en: Incredible head pulping scene in that first episode. When it comes to gore, is there a something that let's you know you've nailed it when you see a scene, and have their been points when you've gone "ooooh too much"
paragraphs.cn: 第一集那个把头打成肉酱的场面真是惊人。说到血腥场面，你看到一场戏时，会凭什么判断它已经达到了理想效果？有没有哪次让你觉得「噢，太过头了」？

paragraphs.en: Bartosz Sztybo: I’m a huge fan of David Cronenberg, Takashi Miike, and Julia Ducournau. I was super impressed in the early 2000s by the French new wave of horror, aka New French Extremity — Martyrs, Haute Tension, Trouble Every Day, À l'intérieur, and Frontier(s). Evil Dead is one of my favorite horror series of all time, so when you ask me about gore — I will always say more is better and I’m so happy that Kai Ikarashi digs that too. We understood each other perfectly, to sometimes go into exaggerated gore and sometimes show violence in a very cold, unemotional way with Cormac McCarthy and Michael Haneke as a reference. For real, in Edgerunners 2, you have never seen violence shown in such a way in the Cyberpunk 2077 universe!
paragraphs.cn: Bartosz Sztybo：我是大卫·柯南伯格、三池崇史和朱利亚·迪库诺的忠实影迷。21世纪初，法国恐怖电影新浪潮，也就是「法国新极端主义」，给我留下了极其深刻的印象，比如《殉难者》《高压电》《日烦夜烦》《身在其中》和《边域之城》。《鬼玩人》是我有史以来最喜欢的恐怖片系列之一，所以如果你问我怎么看血腥场面，我的回答永远是越多越好。我很高兴五十岚海也喜欢这一套。我们非常合拍：有时把血腥表现得夸张一些，有时则参考科马克·麦卡锡和迈克尔·哈内克，以非常冷峻、不带感情的方式呈现暴力。说真的，《边缘行者2》呈现暴力的方式，是你在《赛博朋克2077》宇宙中从未见过的！

paragraphs.en: Saya Elder: Gore and sex are areas where we typically give TRIGGER room to explore the scene organically during the storyboard phase. I've seen Sztybor try to convey the ideal level of violence in the scripts through onomatopoeia, like, “his head goes CRUSH” or "the building goes BOOM”, and maybe throwing out some wildly grotesque ideas for inspiration here or there. TRIGGER usually takes that and amplifies it in a way only they can.
paragraphs.cn: Saya Elder：在血腥和性爱场面上，我们通常会在分镜阶段给TRIGGER留出空间，让他们顺着场景本身来发挥。我见过Sztybor试着在剧本中用拟声词传达理想的暴力程度，比如「他的脑袋咔嚓一声被压碎了」或「大楼轰的一声炸了」，有时或许还会抛出一些极其怪诞的点子来提供灵感。TRIGGER通常会接过这些想法，再用他们独有的方式将其放大。

paragraphs.en: Roman must be protected at all costs - how did his obsession with filmmaking shape the story of season 2?
paragraphs.cn: 一定要保护好Roman——他对电影制作的痴迷，如何影响了第二季的故事？

paragraphs.en: Bartosz Sztybo — Everything was very organic. There was this old idea to include braindances in Edgerunners 2 and we started conversations with TRIGGER and Kai Ikarashi that led to certain narrative and visual choices. So Roman shaped Edgerunners 2, but also Edgerunners 2 created and shaped Roman. It’s inspired by the 90s when cinema was different than it is today, which led to an idea of a kid that thinks there’s value in the past, in a cinematic experience versus being plugged into a braindance. That led to many interesting visual ideas that you will see in the show.
paragraphs.cn: Bartosz Sztybo：一切都很自然。我们很早就想过在《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》中加入超梦，后来开始与TRIGGER和五十岚海讨论，由此确定了一些叙事和视觉上的选择。所以，Roman塑造了《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》，而《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》也创造并塑造了Roman。灵感来自90年代，那时的电影与今天不同。于是我们想到，可以有这样一个孩子：他认为过去的事物有其价值，相比接入超梦，他更看重观看电影的体验。这又带来了许多有趣的视觉创意，大家会在动画中看到。

paragraphs.en: Saya Elder: I actually fought so hard against having a child protagonist at first — I knew the audience would string us up by our thumbs the second anything happened to this baby! But Night City doesn't take it easy for anyone, not even a literal child. Roman is motivated by his desire to capture stories through his camera, and that motivation is the reason he keeps ending up in places where no child should ever be.
paragraphs.cn: Saya Elder：其实我一开始强烈反对让孩子当主角——我知道，这个小宝贝只要一出什么事，观众就会把我们的拇指吊起来示众！但夜之城不会对任何人手下留情，哪怕对方真的是个孩子。Roman一心想用摄像机记录故事，正是这份动力，让他一次次闯入孩子绝不该涉足的地方。

paragraphs.en: I loved the line about why stories matter, was that a theme you discovered early on? It feels very true to the CD Projekt Red ethos.
paragraphs.cn: 我很喜欢那句关于故事为何重要的台词，这是你们很早就确定的主题吗？感觉这很符合CDPR的理念。

paragraphs.en: Bartosz Sztybo: Good stories are CD PROJEKT RED’s ethos, that’s true. And Roman is in a way a self-referential character — he’s my, Kai Ikarashi’s, and Masahiko Otsuka’s love letter to cinema. There’s also some of our experience there, when we dreamed about being filmmakers. And finally, it’s a metaphor for cinema's condition.
paragraphs.cn: Bartosz Sztybo：没错，好故事就是CDPR的核心理念。而Roman在某种程度上也是一个映照我们自己的角色——他是我、五十岚海和大塚雅彦写给电影的一封情书。他身上也有我们当年梦想成为电影人时的一些经历。最后，他也是对电影现状的一种隐喻。

paragraphs.en: Saya Elder: Thank you! One of the themes we wanted to explore throughout the series was the generational loss of storytelling methods and technology. I remember talking to my younger cousins and realizing they had no idea what a VHS tape was. As someone who was raised on Disney and DreamWorks tapes, that was shocking and a little bit alarming. In the same way, old film and cinema represent a form of storytelling that is disappearing from Night City. We wanted to explore that in Edgerunners 2.
paragraphs.cn: Saya Elder：谢谢！我们希望贯穿整部剧集探索的主题之一，就是讲故事的方式和技术如何随着代际更替而失传。我记得有次和年纪较小的堂表亲聊天，发现他们竟然完全不知道VHS录像带是什么。我是看着迪士尼和梦工厂的录像带长大的，这让我很震惊，也有点不安。同样，老胶片和电影也代表着一种正从夜之城消失的叙事方式。我们想在《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》中探讨这一点。

paragraphs.en: Speaking of themes, did the season's darker theme of revenge have any effect on the way you wanted the art style or animation to look to reflect it?
paragraphs.cn: 说到主题，这一季以复仇为主题，基调更为黑暗。这是否影响了你们对美术风格或动画表现的设想，以便体现这一主题？

paragraphs.en: Bartosz Sztybo: The art style and animation are connected to a few things. They’re definitely linked with those 90s inspirations. But also some visual ideas, and the way violence is shown in some places, are sometimes meant to be uncomfortable. That’s not connected to revenge, rather to pivoting into a more realistic approach. And finally, Roman’s character gave us the opportunity to play with different points of views and different ways of visual storytelling.
paragraphs.cn: Bartosz Sztybo：美术风格和动画表现与几个因素有关。它们肯定受到了那些90年代作品的启发。不过，有些视觉构思，以及某些场面对暴力的呈现，有时是刻意要让人感到不适。这与复仇无关，而是为了转向更写实的表现方式。最后，Roman这个角色也让我们有机会尝试不同的视角，以及不同的视觉叙事手法。

paragraphs.en: Saya Elder: D is a character haunted by his past, and that surfaces through nightmare sequences and moments of trauma. TRIGGER portrays this in a very specific way. I won’t speak too much about the art style, since that’s TRIGGER’s domain, but one detail I love in Edgerunners 2 is how sweat is animated. It's very wet, and heavy, and unpleasant to look at. There's something deeply uncomfortable about watching characters break out in a cold seat.
paragraphs.cn: Saya Elder：D始终受到过去的困扰，这一点会通过噩梦片段和创伤发作的时刻表现出来。TRIGGER对此有非常独特的表现方式。美术风格是TRIGGER的领域，我就不多谈了，但《赛博朋克：边缘行者2》里有个细节让我很喜欢，那就是汗水的动画表现。汗水显得非常湿重，看着令人不适。看着角色冒出冷汗，会让人从心底感到不舒服。
